package: "openpipeline_composed"
version: "v0.3.0"
title: "parallel_annotation"
subtitle: "openpipeline_composed v0.3.0"
toc: true
namespace: "Single cell"
description: "Run multiple annotation methods from OpenPipeline in parallel on the same preprocessed query h5mu input, then merge each method's predictions (predicted labels and probabilities in .obs, and integrated embeddings in .obsm for the integration-based methods) back into a single output h5mu."
type: "workflow"
latest: "true"
---

### Info

ID: `parallel_annotation`

[![](/images/viash-hub-logo.svg){.vh-icon} Get run instructions](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_composed/v0.3.0/components/single_cell/parallel_annotation)

:::

These are label-projection (reference-based) methods: they transfer labels from
a labelled --reference onto the query (CellTypist can alternatively use a
pretrained --celltypist_model). The reference is expected to be preprocessed in
the same way as the query.

Available annotation methods: 
- CellTypist
- ScanVI with scArches
- SingleR
- SCVI integration followed by KNN label transfer
- Harmony integration followed by KNN label transfer

Number of differentially expressed genes per label pair to use as markers.
Defaults to a SingleR heuristic based on the number of labels.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_quantile`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Quantile of the correlation distribution used to score each label.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.8`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_fine_tune`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to fine-tune label assignment after the initial classification.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_fine_tuning_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Maximum difference from the maximum correlation to use in fine-tuning.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.05`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_prune`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to prune low-quality labels (replaced with NA in the pruned
predictions output).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::::

### Consensus vote options

A final consensus_vote step combines the per-method predictions into a
single consensus label via a (probability-weighted) majority vote.

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--run_consensus`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Run a final consensus vote combining the per-method predictions. Only
takes effect when more than one --annotation_methods is selected.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_obs_predictions`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs slot in which to store the consensus predicted cell type.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"consensus_pred"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_obs_score`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs slot in which to store the consensus score, defined as the fraction
of total weight assigned to the winning cell type.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"consensus_score"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_use_probabilities`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Scale each method's vote by its per-cell prediction probability. When
false, every method votes with equal weight regardless of confidence.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_tie_label`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Label to assign when two or more cell types receive equal votes. If not
provided, tied cells are assigned a missing value.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"Unknown"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_composed \
  -r v0.3.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/single_cell/parallel_annotation/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_composed/v0.3.0/components/single_cell/parallel_annotation);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_composed \
  -r v0.3.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/single_cell/parallel_annotation/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
